statements.t: “Our priorities are clear: methodically and consistently take the project up the value chain, invest our capital where it can generate the highest returns, and meet or indeed exceed our key milestones.
On June 2, 2026, the Company reported an MRE and SEC Technical Report Summary (“Technical Report”) titled “SEC Technical Report Summary Sinda Project, Guanajuato, Mexico”.
Sinda’s unaudited financial statements and quarterly report on Form 10-Q will be available on the Company’s website at https://investors.sinda.mx/ .

Backed by experienced mining investors and a management team with deep Mexican operating experience, Sinda expects to execute an aggressive exploration and drilling program, and to construct its underground decline enroute to commercial production.
